narr: The remnants of Eastern Pacific Tropical Storm Eugene fueled scattered thunderstorms over southeast California. A few produced flash flooding and strong winds.
ev: Mud, rock, and debris covered Highway 168.
Highway 62 was flooded between Sunfair Rd and Rotary Way.
lsr: California Highway Patrol reports mud, rock, and debris over the road.
Several reports of roadway flooding on WAZE. Reports were on State Route 62, between Sunfair Rd. and Rotary Way. Began 521 pm with estimated end time 605 pm.
